steps.summary: Attempting status change on RD-1016 via "Mark Ready" failed with the app's alert: 'Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd75-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part A" has no supplier Part "fwrd75-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part B" has no supplier' — i.e. the precondition is that every part must have a supplier (the part form lets you save without one). I satisfied it by opening "Edit part" on each row and setting Supplier to "Bench Supplier Co" (Part A and Part B), saving each and waiting for the table to refresh. Retrying "Mark Ready" then succeeded: the buttons changed to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed" and the Status field on the detail page now reads "Ready" (verified by reading the live DOM back: "Ready").

steps.summary: On RD-1016 I clicked "Delete" on Part A, confirmed through the app's in-page "Confirm" dialog (Cancel / "Delete part"; no native browser dialog) and did the same for Part B. After each delete the table refreshed a beat later, and after the second the Parts table contained only the placeholder row "No parts on this ticket yet." (total row gone) — neither part is listed. I then clicked "Archive ticket" on the detail page (no confirmation dialog appeared); the button changed to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared beside the title while Status remained "Ready". Verified on the list page: with "Show archived" checked, searching RD-1016 returns the row "RD-1016 | fwrd75-n2 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer Ltd | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-17", and with Show archived unchecked the list shows "No tickets match the current filters." — so the ticket created by this run is archived and no longer active.
